Background:
At Roche Diagnostics, we develop and deliver life-critical diagnostic solutions that empower healthcare professionals and patients around the globe. Within the Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) organization, an essential pillar of our Global Instrument Network (GIN), we are seeking an experienced, driven Technical Supplier Manager (m/f/d).
In this role, you will be the vital technical bridge connecting our internal engineering and operations teams with our global network of contract manufacturing partners. You will take technical ownership of instrument components, subassemblies, and production lines. jobs.title: CEO (m/f/d) – Bandleader Wanted
jobs.description:
A conductor stands in front of the orchestra and sets the tone with the baton. A bandleader stands right in the middle, plays along, counts in – and listens carefully to know when it’s time for others’ solos.
That’s exactly the person we are looking for: someone to lead our family-oriented marketing and fundraising agency into the next generation. With groove, with conviction, and with joy in the shared sound.
The Band
asm Fundraising AG has been playing for non-profit organisations, foundations, and public institutions for more than 40 years – on stages throughout Switzerland and in several languages. Our 20 musicians master a wide range of instruments: strategy, creation, data, and fundraising.
What holds us together is not a sheet of music, but a shared attitude. Reliability, respect, and the commitment to serve the cause are the fundamental tone on which everything is built. When planning the tour, the board of directors is on board: as sparring partners who listen, think along, and help shape the shared sound.
Your Role in the Band
• Keep the groove: You set the strategic direction, think ahead, and develop the agency’s repertoire together with the board of directors.
• Play along instead of conducting: You stand in the middle of the team, lead appreciatively and with strong implementation skills, and embody our values – out of conviction, not obligation.
• Enable solos: You recognise talents, nurture and coach them, delegate gladly, and blend individual voices into new sounds.
• Compile the setlist: You manage the client portfolio according to profitability and complexity, win new mandates, and recognise which pieces fit together.
• Keep in time: You have a firm grasp of numbers, key figures, and controlling, use contract models flexibly, and ensure structures that work even without you.
• Dare new pieces: You question the status quo, drive digitalisation forward, and create space for improvisation – without losing sight of the final chord.
• Stand on stage: You represent the agency credibly externally and remain calm when a string breaks.
What You Bring
Your Instrument Case
• Tertiary-level degree (FH or university), ideally with CAS or MBA
• Experience as a managing director or member of executive management
• Fundraising understanding and a network in the NPO and philanthropy sector
• Solid business management skills, negotiation skills, and project management experience
• Digital judgement that does not lose sight of people – with a fine ear for critical questions and feedback
• Understanding of the interplay within federalist Switzerland
• Fluent in German and French, very good in English; Italian is your bonus
Your Sense of Rhythm
• You feel at home in a family business and enjoy playing in an ensemble.
• You are honest, loyal, and reliable – the music is more important than your own applause.
• You listen before you play: with high emotional intelligence and sensitivity to constellations.
• You find the right tone for every audience – from the Federal Councillor to the cleaning staff.
• You make complex things sound simple and create clarity when it gets loud.
• You are curious, courageous, and seek advice when a part is new.
What We Offer You
• Your place on stage: the centre of a well-rehearsed, interdisciplinary band
• A repertoire with meaning: mandates for organisations that advance society and the environment
• Freedom for new arrangements: plenty of creative freedom and a careful handover – we play the first pieces together
• A rehearsal room with the best acoustics: central location in Zurich and modern office infrastructure
• Breaks between concerts: 5 or 6 weeks’ holiday so you return to the stage with fresh energy
• A sound that resonates – even after the last tour: attractive personal insurance, especially strong occupational pension plans, with contributions mostly covered by us
Fancy a jam session?
Then count in: Send us your complete application documents. We are also happy to offer an initial preliminary discussion. Discretion is, of course, guaranteed.

jobs.description:
Entdecke deine nächste Karrierechance bei einem der größten Logistikdienstleister der Welt. Stelle dir die Vielzahl an Möglichkeiten vor, etwas zu bewegen und werde Teil eines großartigen Teams aus ganz unterschiedlichen Kulturen. Wir wissen, was nötig ist, um UPS in die Zukunft zu führen: Menschen mit einer einzigartigen Kombination aus Können und Leidenschaft. Wenn du die Eigenschaften und die Motivation besitzt, dich selbst oder dein Team zu führen, findest du bei uns den Job, der zu dir passt. Bei UPS erhältst du die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten unter Beweis zu stellen und deine Karriere auf ein neues Level zu bringen.

Tätigkeitsbeschreibung:

Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics (formerly Marken, MNX & Polar Speed), the clinical and advanced therapy subsidiary of UPS Healthcare, unites expertise across healthcare and complex secure logistics to drive the success of our clients through innovation.

Job Purpose:
A Business Development Director works to improve an organization’s market position and achieve financial growth. This person defines long-term organizational strategic goals, builds key customer relationships, identifies business opportunities, negotiates and closes business deals and maintains extensive knowledge of current market conditions. Business Development Directors work in a senior sales position within the company. It is their job to work with their internal team, marketing staff, and other Directors and Managers to increase sales opportunities and thereby maximize revenue for Marken.

To achieve this, they need to find potential new customers, present to them, ultimately convert them into clients, and continue to grow business in the future. The Business Development Director will also help manage existing clients and ensure they stay satisfied and positive. They call on clients, often being required to make presentations on solutions and services that meet or predict their clients’ future needs.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
The primary role of the Business Development Director is to prospect for new clients by networking, cold calling, advertising or other means of generating interest from potential clients. They must then plan persuasive approaches and pitches that will convince potential clients to do business with the company. They must develop a rapport with new clients, and set targets for sales and provide support that will continually improve the relationship. They are also required to grow and retain existing accounts by presenting new solutions and services to clients. Business Development Directors work with mid and senior level management, marketing, and technical staff. He/she may manage the activities of others responsible for developing business for the company. Strategic planning is a key part of this job description, since it is the business manager’s responsibility to develop the pipeline of new business coming in to the company. This requires a thorough knowledge of the market, the solutions/services the company can provide, and of the company’s competitors. While the exact responsibilities will vary the main duties of the Business Development Director can be summarized as follows:

New Business Development
• Prospect for potential new clients and turn this into increased business.
• Cold call as appropriate within your market or geographic area to ensure a robust pipeline of opportunities.
• Meet potential clients by growing, maintaining, and leveraging your network.
• Identify potential clients, and the decision makers within the client organization.
• Research and build relationships with new clients.
• Set up meetings between client decision makers and company’s practice leaders/Principals.
• Plan approaches and pitches.
• Work with team to develop proposals that speaks to the client’s needs, concerns, and objectives.
• Participate in pricing the solution/service.
• Handle objections by clarifying, emphasizing agreements and working through differences to a positive conclusion.
• Use a variety of styles to persuade or negotiate appropriately.
• Present an image that mirrors that of the client

Client Retention
• Present new products and services and enhance existing relationships.
• Work with technical staff and other internal colleagues to meet customer needs. Arrange and participate in internal and external client debriefs.

Business Development Planning
• Attend industry functions, such as association events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
• Present to and consult with mid and senior level management on business trends with a view to developing new services, products, and distribution channels.
• Identify opportunities for campaigns, services, and distribution channels that will lead to an increase in sales.
• Using knowledge of the market and competitors, identify and develop the company’s unique selling propositions and differentiators.

Management and Research
• Ensure that data is accurately entered and managed within SalesForce.
• Track and record activity on accounts and help to close deals to meet these targets.
• Research and develop a thorough understanding of the company’s people and capabilities.
• Understand the company’s goal and purpose so that will continual to enhance the company’s performance.

Requirements: Education
• Bachelor’s degree
• Minimum 5-7 years of sales or marketing experience.

jobs.title: Rechtsberater Digitales Recht (ID2201)
jobs.description:
Die AO ist eine medizinisch geleitete, gemeinnützige Organisation, ein globales Netzwerk von Chirurgen und die weltweit führende Bildungs-, Innovations- und Forschungsorganisation, die sich auf die chirurgische Behandlung von Traumata und muskuloskelettalen Erkrankungen spezialisiert hat. Wir sind Heimat für Menschen aus aller Welt, mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, vielfältigen Talenten und Fachgebieten. Was uns verbindet, ist unsere Leidenschaft für Exzellenz, unser Engagement für unsere Mission, die Patientenversorgung zu verbessern, und unser Verständnis, dass wir gemeinsam stärker sind: Wir sind eine AO.
Für weitere Informationen besuchen Sie: https://www.aofoundation.org/
Rechtsberater Digitales Recht (ID2201)

Als Teil der Unterstützungsbereiche der AO ist Legal and Compliance darauf ausgerichtet, sicherzustellen, dass die AO Foundation Gesetze und Vorschriften einhält, rechtliche Risiken minimiert und ethische Standards wahrt.

Als Rechtsberater Digitales Recht arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Recht, Technologie, Datenschutz und künstlicher Intelligenz und unterstützen die Organisation dabei, sich in einem zunehmend dynamischen digitalen Regulierungsumfeld zurechtzufinden, unter Anleitung und Umsetzung von Rahmenwerken, die vom Global Principal Digital Law AI & Data Governance, Data Privacy & DPO entworfen wurden.

Während der Abwesenheit oder Nichtverfügbarkeit des Global Principal Digital Law AI & Data Governance, Data Privacy & DPO vertreten Sie ihn/sie auch in der Rolle des Datenschutzbeauftragten (DPO) und gewährleisten so die Kontinuität der gesetzlichen DPO-Funktion.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:

• Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung des Datenschutzrahmens unter Aufsicht und Anleitung des Global Principal Digital Law AI & Data Governance, Data Privacy & DPO: • Erstellung interner und externer Dokumentationen, Richtlinien, Haftungsausschlüsse und Hinweise, Ausführung und Koordination innerhalb etablierter Vorlagen
• Durchführung (Verhandlung und Abschluss) routinemässiger Datenverarbeitungsvereinbarungen (DPA) und Datenfreigabevereinbarungen innerhalb etablierter Rahmenwerke und Vorlagen
• Unterstützung bei der Pflege und Aktualisierung der Verzeichnisse von Verarbeitungstätigkeiten (RoPA), einschließlich Aufnahme neuer Verarbeitungstätigkeiten aus den Geschäftsbereichen und Koordination mit den Abteilungen
• Unterstützung bei Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen (DPIAs), einschließlich Koordination mit relevanten Geschäfts- und technischen Stakeholdern
• Mitwirkung bei Vorfallreaktionen und Prozessen zur Behandlung von Datenschutzverletzungen nach Anweisung

• Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung des AI-Governance-Rahmens unter Aufsicht und Anleitung des Global Principal Digital Law AI & Data Governance, Data Privacy & DPO: • Verwaltung des Prozesses zur Aufnahme und Bewertung von KI-Anwendungsfällen
• Unterstützung bei der Risikoklassifizierung von KI-Systemen gemäß der EU-KI-Verordnung und vergleichbaren Rahmenwerken
• Pflege des KI-Risikoregisters

• Mitwirkung bei der Gestaltung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Datenschutz und digitaler Compliance für Mitarbeitende beider Einheiten
• Unterstützung des Global Principal Digital Law AI & Data Governance, Data Privacy & DPO bei der Überwachung rechtlicher und regulatorischer Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Datenschutz, Digitalrecht und KI-Governance sowie Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung notwendiger Änderungen und Anforderungen
• Fungieren als sekundärer Ansprechpartner für interne Stakeholder bei routinemässigen Fragen und Anfragen zum Datenschutz und zur digitalen Compliance

Hauptanforderungen:

• Juristischer Abschluss (Bachelor und/oder Master); Schweizer oder EU-Qualifikation
• Erfahrung als juristischer Fachmann (Rechtsanwalt, Berater oder Ähnliches) in einem Unternehmen, einer Kanzlei oder Beratung
• Relevante Berufserfahrung in IT-bezogenen Rechtsthemen, Datenschutz, Digitalrecht, KI-Governance ist von Vorteil
• Hohe Detailgenauigkeit und Präferenz für eine operative, prozessorientierte juristische Arbeit
• Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise, juristischer Pragmatismus
• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit Stakeholdern; Fähigkeit zur Arbeit in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Teams und Umgebungen
• Fließende Englischkenntnisse erforderlich; Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus

Bevorzugte Fähigkeiten:
• Praktische Erfahrung mit Datenschutzanforderungen nach DSGVO und dem Schweizer FADP; Vertrautheit mit dem globalen und EU-Digitalrechtsumfeld sowie der EU-KI-Verordnung ist ein starkes Plus
• Grundlegendes Verständnis von IT-Systemen und Erfahrung mit IT-/Cloud-Lösungen, Datenflüssen und Cloud-/Anbieterarchitektur ist ein starkes Plus. Praktische Erfahrung oder persönliches Interesse an KI-Lösungen und den relevanten rechtlichen Anforderungen und Rahmenwerken weltweit ist ein starkes Plus
• Interesse an kontinuierlichem Lernen und Wachstum in Themen zu aufkommenden Technologien sowie Bereitschaft, mit dem schnelllebigen regulatorischen Umfeld Schritt zu halten

• Eine interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einer spannenden und innovativen Organisation
• Die Möglichkeit, Teil eines hoch engagierten internationalen Teams zu sein
• Moderne Infrastruktur
• Hoher Grad an Flexibilität bezüglich Arbeitszeiten und -ort (abhängig von den betrieblichen Anforderungen)
• Grosszügiges Sozialleistungspaket, einschließlich zusätzlicher Urlaubstage und Beiträge zur Pensionskasse
• Interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Unterstützung bei der beruflichen Fortbildung

Join our team as a Business Analyst in Client Lifecycle! Shape client processes.

Tasks

• Optimize end-to-end processes like onboarding and KYC.

• Translate business requirements into actionable solutions.

• Drive initiatives from concept to productive implementation.

Skills

• Experience bridging business and IT, especially in banking.

• Strong analytical skills for business processes and solutions.

• Proficiency in agile methodologies and team collaboration.

Your Role:
• You design and optimise end-to-end processes along the client lifecycle (e.g.
• Onboarding, KYC, mutations)
• You structure business requirements and translate them into actionable business and technical solutions
• You actively drive initiatives from idea to productive implementation
• You take responsibility for the digitalisation of customer processes and implement them together with the team
• You actively contribute to the further development of the roadmap, bring in your own ideas and keep the customer at the centre

Your Education and Experience:
• You are confident at the interface between business and IT and know how to translate business requirements into actionable solutions
• You have solid experience in analysing requirements and business processes as well as in developing viable solution concepts
• You have not only designed digital solutions in the customer context but also accompanied them through to implementation and successfully introduced them
• Experience in the banking environment or in the client lifecycle (e.g.
• Onboarding, KYC) is an advantage
• Avaloq knowledge is an advantage

Your Way of Working:
• You work in a structured way in an agile environment and keep an overview even with complex topics
• You proactively drive topics forward and take responsibility for the results
• You enjoy working hands-on and bring solutions to implementation together with the team
• You bring an innovative mindset and a strong willingness to take ownership

Your Team:

You are part of an interdisciplinary team in the client lifecycle, consisting of business analysts, developers and subject matter experts. We work in a Scrum setup with close exchange, short decision-making paths and a high standard for the quality of our solutions. You benefit from an environment where ideas quickly become reality.

Your Perspective with Us:

As part of the Client Lifecycle stream, you actively shape the customer experience throughout the entire lifecycle. You work in an interdisciplinary team - from conception through design to technical implementation - and benefit from short decision-making paths and high implementation speed. You consistently bring topics into implementation, take responsibility and drive projects from idea to productive solution.
